subject: Bundle pricing question: long-term retention & advanced telemetry UI (Adept)
messages:
From: Natalie Brooks <natalie@adeptanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Adept Analytics Procurement <procurement@adeptanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Telemetry add-ons — retention & dashboards pricing questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the low latency on the hosted endpoints and the new live-query dashboard. We are kicking off internal scoping for our Q1 pilot and need clearer pricing for the telemetry add-ons so we can budget. Two quick asks: 

1) For long-term retention: we currently plan to retain traces+logs for 365 days for compliance, but would consider a 90-day plus archive pattern if the math works. Can you provide per-GB-month pricing for active retention tiers (30/90/365) and archival pricing? Also any egress or retrieval fees to be aware of.

2) For advanced dashboards: we need a seat model for 8 analysts + 2 admin seats and export/export-to-S3 capabilities. Is there a flat SKU for the advanced UI or is it per-seat?

We have a procurement timeline: initial PO by Dec 15, pilot in Jan. The finance team is sensitive to multi-line item pass-throughs, so if you have a bundled offer that simplifies billing that would help. Attached is a short scoping doc from our infra lead (see references).

Would appreciate a concise quote and a sketch of discount thresholds for a 12-month commit.

Best,
Natalie
Natalie Brooks
Head of Platform — Adept Analytics

Attachment: adept-scope-telemetry-20261101.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie@adeptanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention & dashboards pricing questions

Hi Natalie — great to hear the demo landed well. Appreciated the scoping doc. I put together a short pricing note (summary below) and attached a PDF with SKU definitions and an example invoice layout to make procurement easier.

Quick summary (pilot / 12-month commit pricing, USD):
- Active retention (per GB-month): 30d = $0.20/GB-mo, 90d = $0.14/GB-mo, 365d = $0.09/GB-mo
- Archive storage (cold, retrieval-friendly): $0.02/GB-mo; retrieval/restore: $0.10/GB (one-time on restore)
- Tracing ingestion (spans): $1.50 / 1M spans (first 50M spans included in pilot credit)
- Advanced dashboards: $85 / analyst seat / month; admin seats = $120 / seat / month
- Bulk export to S3 (push): $0.03 / GB exported; ad-hoc exports via console included up to 10 GB / mo

Bundling concession we can offer for a 12-month committed pilot (single PO, single SOW):
- Option A (pilot bundle): 15% off list on combined observability add-ons (retention + tracing + dashboards) for the first 3 months while you ramp
- Option B (annual commit): 20% off list on observability add-ons if you sign a 12-month revenue commit >= $120k ARR for the add-ons

Notes / constraints:
- Pricing above assumes hosted Redwood telemetry; private/on-prem ingestion adds a setup fee and changes archive pricing.
- Discounts above are stackable with seat-volume concessions (>=25 seats) but not combinable with channel or reseller credits.

I attached an example invoice layout and a draft SOW (SOW-Adept-Analytics-draft.docx) so your procurement team can review the line items in one consolidated bill.

Next steps: if you want, we can run the sample usage through our pricing calculator and return a proforma invoice this week.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Adept Analytics Procurement <procurement@adeptanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention & dashboards pricing questions

Hi Priya / Kimberly,

Thanks for the breakdown. Procurement + finance ran the numbers and had two asks before we scope the PO: 

1) Adept is requesting a 25% discount on the observability bundle (retention + tracing + dashboards) for the first 6 months of the contract to accommodate pilot costs. Our target ARR for the add-ons is $150k+. Is there room to move beyond 20%?

2) The finance team would prefer billing as a single line item "Telemetry Add-ons — Pilot (12mo)" rather than three separate SKUs. Can you provide a consolidated SKU with the applied discount and the same SOW? That will make our AP routing much simpler.

We are flexible on retention profile: we can start with 90d active + 275d cold if that helps reduce cost and still meet compliance.

Appreciate quick confirmation — procurement wants the PO by Dec 15.

Best,
John Lee (on behalf of Adept Procurement)
procurement@adeptanalytics.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Adept Analytics Procurement <procurement@adeptanalytics.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie@adeptanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention & dashboards pricing questions

John / Natalie — thanks for the clear asks. Internally looped in Kimberly and Jordan to make sure legal/procurement language and billing flow cleanly. Short answers:

1) Discount: we can approve a 25% concession on the observability bundle for the first 6 months provided the customer signs the 12-month SOW with a minimum committed spend of $140k for the add-ons (covers both pilot and production months). This is a stretch versus our standard 20% but reasonable given the ARR target you cited.

2) Consolidated billing: yes — we will produce a single consolidated SKU line in the SOW & invoice labeled "Telemetry Add-ons — Pilot (12mo)" with the discount applied. The underlying SKU breakouts will remain in the attached SOW appendix for audit but won’t appear on the AP-facing invoice.

Retention change: the 90d active + 275d cold profile works and lowers the first-year add-ons cost by ~18% versus 365d active — we will reflect that in the proforma.

I'll update the SOW and registration of the HubSpot deal today and paste the DocuSign link once ready. Expect the updated SOW attached to the DocuSign envelope within 48 hours.

Next steps: once you confirm the $140k minimum and the 6-month 25% concession, we'll route legal and generate the single-line PO-friendly invoice and the DocuSign SOW.

— Priya
